newForms.name: Blazewyrm
newForms.lore: Its wings finally caught up with its ego. Both are considerable.

newForms.name: Infernowyrm
newForms.lore: Flies close enough to the sun that the sun occasionally complains.

newForms.name: Solarwyrm
newForms.lore: Ember Scar's oldest legend: a dragon that got so bright, the maps just mark that spot 'noon, always'.

newForms.name: Tidewalker
newForms.lore: Walks further inland every year, just to prove the sky is still there.

newForms.name: Skysurge
newForms.lore: Leaps so high on stormy days that gulls mistake it for one of their own.

newForms.name: Tidesovereign
newForms.lore: Old river-folk say the tide doesn't come in on its own anymore — it's summoned.

newForms.name: Mycotitan
newForms.lore: Its cap alone shades half a glade. Smaller Mystics hold court beneath it.

newForms.name: Elderbloom
newForms.lore: The forest's oldest memory, wearing a crown of every mushroom that ever looked up to it.

newForms.name: Thorngloop
newForms.lore: Grew actual thorns after the spikes stopped being enough of a hint.

newForms.name: Briargloop
newForms.lore: Rolls through the Vale leaving a hedge of brambles wherever it naps.

newForms.name: Grovegloop
newForms.lore: Half moss, half thicket, all grudge — it remembers every single sat-on afternoon.

newForms.name: Chirpeak
newForms.lore: Grew a little crest. Absolutely insufferable about it now.

newForms.name: Hawklet
newForms.lore: Practices its hawk screech every morning. It is getting better, slowly.

newForms.name: Skytalon
newForms.lore: Finally has real talons. Still can't quite believe its own luck.

newForms.name: Stormtalon
newForms.lore: The self-belief paid off. Ask it what it is and it will simply let you look up.

newForms.name: Peckstone
newForms.lore: Started pecking bigger stones. Considers this a promotion.

newForms.name: Geopeck
newForms.lore: Cracked its first geode by accident. Hasn't stopped looking for a second one since.

newForms.name: Craghen
newForms.lore: Nests are just a pile of its favourite rocks now. It is very proud of the pile.

newForms.name: Boulderplume
newForms.lore: The proudest rockhound in Stormreach; every gem in its plumage, it found and kept itself.

newForms.name: Cloudhop
newForms.lore: Naps are getting longer. So are the clouds it naps on.

newForms.name: Skyhopper
newForms.lore: Has started collecting favourite clouds the way other Mystics collect pebbles.

newForms.name: Stormbounder
newForms.lore: Bounces off thunderheads like they're trampolines. The thunder does not appreciate this.

newForms.name: Zenithare
newForms.lore: Legend says it leapt once and simply never fully came down again.

newForms.name: Spinewarden
newForms.lore: Doubled its spines after the last sandstorm nearly toppled it. Never again.

newForms.name: Thornbastion
newForms.lore: Whole caravans reroute around it rather than risk a hug.

newForms.name: Desertking
newForms.lore: Every spring in the Dunes owes its water to something this old choosing, once, to stay and guard it.

newForms.name: Sparkcat
newForms.lore: Its fur crackles audibly now. Thunderstorms make it purr.

newForms.name: Stormlynx
newForms.lore: Pounces trailed by little forks of lightning. The mice do not stand a chance.

newForms.name: Boltpanther
newForms.lore: Runs so fast the thunderclap catches up a full second late.

newForms.name: Thundermane
newForms.lore: A storm given a heartbeat and a hunting instinct; when it roars, the sky roars back.

newForms.name: Cragroose
newForms.lore: Upgraded to boulders. Rivals now keep a respectful distance during juggling hour.

newForms.name: Boulderoose
newForms.lore: Juggles three boulders at once and has never once dropped the bit.

newForms.name: Stonemoose
newForms.lore: Antlers grew stone-heavy, so it just started juggling those too.

newForms.name: Titanroose
newForms.lore: The undisputed champion of every juggling contest in Stormreach — mostly because no one else can lift the props.

prompts.name: Emberling
prompts.prompt: A small round hatchling drake with stubby wings and a soot-smudged snout, warm orange-red scales and tiny curling smoke-wisps from its nostrils.

prompts.name: Pyrowyrm
prompts.prompt: A lean young dragon with bigger wings trailing faint embers, deep red-orange scales along its back fading to a paler belly, eyes glowing like coals.

prompts.name: Blazewyrm
prompts.prompt: A longer, more muscular dragon with wide flame-edged wings and a spiked ridge down its spine, scales deepening to a richer red with brighter ember trails.

prompts.name: Infernowyrm
prompts.prompt: A powerful dragon whose wings now trail continuous ribbons of fire, its scales a deep molten red-orange with a crown of small horns glowing at the tips.

prompts.name: Solarwyrm
prompts.prompt: A magnificent dragon sovereign with vast wings that blaze like sunset clouds, its scales a radiant gradient from molten gold to deep ember-red, crowned in a blazing horn-corona.

prompts.name: Finnik
prompts.prompt: A small blue fish standing improbably on two stubby legs, wide curious eyes and a fin-crest like a little crown, pale blue scales with a silver belly.

prompts.name: Tidecaller
prompts.prompt: A taller fish-being with confident webbed legs and flowing fin-crest, deeper blue scales with silver highlights, one fin raised as if commanding a wave.

prompts.name: Tidewalker
prompts.prompt: A more upright, striding fish-being with longer legs and a rippling fin-mane, deep blue scales patterned like flowing water, eyes bright with certainty.

prompts.name: Skysurge
prompts.prompt: An athletic, leaping fish-being with wing-like pectoral fins spread wide, glossy sapphire scales catching light like sea-spray, fin-crest streaming behind it.

prompts.name: Tidesovereign
prompts.prompt: A regal, towering tide-being with vast flowing fin-wings and a crown-like dorsal crest, deep sapphire-to-navy scales glowing faintly at the seams like moonlit water.

prompts.name: Sporelet
prompts.prompt: A small round mushroom-capped creature napping in a sunbeam, soft brown cap with pale speckles and sleepy half-closed eyes.

prompts.name: Mycobloom
prompts.prompt: A taller mushroom creature with a wider, gently glowing cap and calm round eyes, warm tan cap deepening at the gills, faint spores drifting from it.

prompts.name: Sporeking
prompts.prompt: A regal mushroom monarch with a broad crowned cap and sturdy stance, rich amber cap with darker gill-folds, a calm and commanding gaze.

prompts.name: Mycotitan
prompts.prompt: A towering mushroom titan whose cap has grown tiered like a pagoda, deep amber-brown ridges with glowing spore-flecks, roots thick as tree trunks.

prompts.name: Elderbloom
prompts.prompt: An ancient, majestic mushroom sovereign whose vast tiered cap is a canopy of its own, glowing spore-light drifting from every gill, ringed in smaller mushrooms that grew up looking to it.

prompts.name: Gloop
prompts.prompt: A soft, round wobbling blob of moss-green jelly with two sleepy dot eyes and a faint happy hum-shimmer.

prompts.name: Spikegloop
prompts.prompt: A spikier blob bristling with short soft thorns, deeper green jelly with a slightly grumpy pinched expression.

prompts.name: Thorngloop
prompts.prompt: A broader blob now covered in true woody thorns radiating outward, richer forest-green jelly with small leaf-buds sprouting between spikes.

prompts.name: Briargloop
prompts.prompt: A bramble-wrapped blob whose thorns have grown into tangled woody vines around its body, deep green jelly barely visible beneath a living hedge.

prompts.name: Grovegloop
prompts.prompt: A towering thicket given a wobbling jelly heart, its whole body a dense woven briar-mound sprouting leaves and small flowers, deep mossy green glimpsed only at the seams.

prompts.name: Chirpling
prompts.prompt: A small round fluffy bird puffed up like a cotton ball, dusty teal feathers and a tiny stern expression trying very hard to look fierce.

prompts.name: Chirpeak
prompts.prompt: A slightly leaner round bird sporting a small proud crest of feathers, teal plumage deepening with the faintest cyan sheen, still puffed but a touch more purposeful.

prompts.name: Hawklet
prompts.prompt: A gawky, half-grown hawk-shape emerging from the fluff, longer wings and a sharper little beak, teal-cyan feathers with the first true flight feathers coming in.

prompts.name: Skytalon
prompts.prompt: A sleek young hawk with strong wings and real talons at last, rich teal-cyan plumage with darker wingtip markings and a fiercely confident stare.

prompts.name: Stormtalon
prompts.prompt: A magnificent storm-hawk with vast sweeping wings and glinting talons, deep teal-to-slate plumage crackling faintly at the wingtips, its stare finally as fierce as it always claimed.

prompts.name: Pecklet
prompts.prompt: A small round dusty-orange hen pecking at pebbles, stubby wings and a determined little beak, one shiny stone already tucked under a wing.

prompts.name: Peckstone
prompts.prompt: A slightly bigger hen with a rocky crest of small stones along its head, warm terracotta feathers and stronger stubby legs for digging.

prompts.name: Geopeck
prompts.prompt: A sturdier hen whose crest has grown into jagged little rock spikes, deep ochre-brown feathers dusted with mineral flecks, a geode shard clutched proudly in one foot.

prompts.name: Craghen
prompts.prompt: A broad, boulder-shouldered hen with a thick rocky mane down its neck, rich rust-brown plumage textured like canyon stone, small gems embedded along its crest.

prompts.name: Boulderplume
prompts.prompt: A magnificent, powerfully built rock-hen whose entire plumage glitters with embedded gems and polished stones, deep earthen browns capped by a crown of crystal-tipped feathers, sturdy enough to carry a rider across the Peaks.

prompts.name: Hopscotch
prompts.prompt: A small fluffy bunny mid-leap with oversized hind legs and wide bright eyes, soft teal-white fur ruffled by the wind.

prompts.name: Cloudhop
prompts.prompt: A slightly bigger bunny with longer ears that catch the breeze like little sails, fluffy teal-white fur now tipped with faint cloud-wisp fluff.

prompts.name: Skyhopper
prompts.prompt: A lean, athletic hare with long wind-swept ears and powerful hind legs, teal-cyan fur streaked with faster-moving cloud patterns along its back.

prompts.name: Stormbounder
prompts.prompt: A powerful hare crackling faintly at the ear-tips with static, storm-teal fur ruffled like a coiled spring, always mid-bounce.

prompts.name: Zenithare
prompts.prompt: A majestic celestial hare with vast wind-swept ears trailing wisps of actual cloud, radiant teal-white fur glowing faintly at each gust, forever caught mid-leap above the world.

prompts.name: Pricklet
prompts.prompt: A small round cactus creature bristling with soft spines, dusty sage green with a faintly worried expression and two stubby arm-nubs.

prompts.name: Saguardian
prompts.prompt: A tall standing cactus sentinel with thick spined arms crossed protectively, deep green ridged body with a calm, watchful stare.

prompts.name: Spinewarden
prompts.prompt: A broader cactus guardian with denser spine-clusters along both arms and a small flower-crown budding at its crown, richer forest-green ridges.

prompts.name: Thornbastion
prompts.prompt: A hulking cactus bastion with thick armoured ridges and long defensive spines radiating outward, deep green body dotted with small white blossoms.

prompts.name: Desertking
prompts.prompt: A towering, ancient cactus monarch crowned in a full ring of desert blossoms, its immense ridged body a deep, venerable green standing eternal watch over a hidden spring.

prompts.name: Voltcat
prompts.prompt: A small sleek cat with fur that stands on end from static, pale yellow coat with darker lightning-bolt markings and bright spark-flecked eyes.

prompts.name: Sparkcat
prompts.prompt: A leaner, more energetic cat with visibly crackling fur-tips, richer gold coat with sharper bolt-markings, tail flicking little sparks.

prompts.name: Stormlynx
prompts.prompt: An athletic lynx with tufted, static-charged ear-tips and powerful haunches, deep amber-gold fur patterned with branching lightning streaks.

prompts.name: Boltpanther
prompts.prompt: A sleek, powerful panther crackling with constant static along its spine, dark gold fur with glowing lightning-vein markings and fierce storm-bright eyes.

prompts.name: Thundermane
prompts.prompt: A majestic storm-panther with a crackling mane of living lightning, deep bronze-gold fur veined in glowing bolts, eyes blazing like the heart of a thunderhead.

prompts.name: Monkroose
prompts.prompt: A sturdy monkey-moose hybrid with small antlers and dexterous hands, sandy brown fur, mid-toss with a river stone in each hand.

prompts.name: Cragroose
prompts.prompt: A broader monkroose with thicker antlers and stronger arms, deeper tan fur, now juggling fist-sized rocks with easy confidence.

prompts.name: Boulderoose
prompts.prompt: A muscular monkroose whose antlers have grown rugged and rock-textured, rich ochre fur, effortlessly keeping three stones aloft at once.

prompts.name: Stonemoose
prompts.prompt: A powerful moose-ape with heavy stone-plated antlers and broad juggler's shoulders, deep terracotta fur dusted with rock grit.

prompts.name: Titanroose
prompts.prompt: A towering titan of a moose-ape with massive crystal-veined antlers and boulder-sized hands, richly textured earthen fur, effortlessly balancing stones the size of boulders overhead.
